docs: Header content: the brand (a link home), an ordered list of navigation links and one action. One object is valid in every header layout (inline, the links at the end, centred).

brand.docs: the name of the site (the link home)

brandHref.docs: the address of the home page

links.docs: the navigation links, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

actionLabel.docs: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set
